Most people metabolize alcohol at a steady average rate of about **0.015% blood alcohol concentration (BAC) per hour** —roughly one standard drink per hour—and nothing can reliably speed up this clearance rate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF13T4dFGvJ-2UXqJPDrf6gzfijug39VwIkAZoIxlb5MUp-pgWg4B589iV8NCc7DcfGx7GooE8ofQUMSgIGkfzCzRT2XTf1rfkgNTJ6K4NzpSfK09JEtUVfL50K73kzX-N3Yy_DYNEns1tBV5TkV1HPgfclqtljpE6nKbnoPxbj1pzLsSQ4aNE6HjmiP54u5i0xYvX)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xFmw3GauO56T5L-83bTmGt-bTt1O8S2rgtXDoeoy8_fOavm6j6R2HPb23Vv-Ph4BhISfOugObxDoFodbZG-1nQXJvaeSLToKr_xHGFBjkCPJrMRAzXQCooj4njfZWXJ5mLYSi2xtiuM5HLBIf2yPZxg07WODghmskA22eGf6ZhJ4_FviKg6I1JFQAKOKbEgfv99AyJnMrGu)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXvjmjX-cOAozECphne7A0CSyyO7LMbh3TiQS0chyKxaMuCU5ZS8b9inFuI_NzAYvY5Rm1Yltboo0aI1m9KK3ou1A3SKg2wC3OkV8pajSsiF6ujO2HtaxB1-4J55PWlq8-Bp1oLFATrEhTDgJAguYjZ2gvwg)

### How Your Body Processes Alcohol

- **Primary liver enzymes:** Alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) converts alcohol into acetaldehyde (a toxic compound), and aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH) breaks acetaldehyde down into acetate, which is eventually eliminated as water and carbon dioxide.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXoturtsrQB87JCR_vZdJcNzoCexADgcihgVHdsIuTOdsnsRJx4x4tNaQUIIPf1G_6DTS4En2xIcddixrOrwiwz3cv-OxwaCK7vHVSg3QI5U_8j7yC77P9yzuWN0vAICAwYHtpGfGbtVheSgSnxj1oiPU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXvjmjX-cOAozECphne7A0CSyyO7LMbh3TiQS0chyKxaMuCU5ZS8b9inFuI_NzAYvY5Rm1Yltboo0aI1m9KK3ou1A3SKg2wC3OkV8pajSsiF6ujO2HtaxB1-4J55PWlq8-Bp1oLFATrEhTDgJAguYjZ2gvwg)
- **Other elimination routes:** A small fraction (around 10%) leaves the body through breath, sweat, and urine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xFmw3GauO56T5L-83bTmGt-bTt1O8S2rgtXDoeoy8_fOavm6j6R2HPb23Vv-Ph4BhISfOugObxDoFodbZG-1nQXJvaeSLToKr_xHGFBjkCPJrMRAzXQCooj4njfZWXJ5mLYSi2xtiuM5HLBIf2yPZxg07WODghmskA22eGf6ZhJ4_FviKg6I1JFQAKOKbEgfv99AyJnMrGu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF13T4dFGvJ-2UXqJPDrf6gzfijug39VwIkAZoIxlb5MUp-pgWg4B589iV8NCc7DcfGx7GooE8ofQUMSgIGkfzCzRT2XTf1rfkgNTJ6K4NzpSfK09JEtUVfL50K73kzX-N3Yy_DYNEns1tBV5TkV1HPgfclqtljpE6nKbnoPxbj1pzLsSQ4aNE6HjmiP54u5i0xYvX)
- **No true "speed-up" tricks:** Drinking coffee, taking cold showers, exercising, or drinking water may make you feel more alert or hydrated, but they do not speed up how fast your liver clears alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXvjmjX-cOAozECphne7A0CSyyO7LMbh3TiQS0chyKxaMuCU5ZS8b9inFuI_NzAYvY5Rm1Yltboo0aI1m9KK3ou1A3SKg2wC3OkV8pajSsiF6ujO2HtaxB1-4J55PWlq8-Bp1oLFATrEhTDgJAguYjZ2gvwg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xFmw3GauO56T5L-83bTmGt-bTt1O8S2rgtXDoeoy8_fOavm6j6R2HPb23Vv-Ph4BhISfOugObxDoFodbZG-1nQXJvaeSLToKr_xHGFBjkCPJrMRAzXQCooj4njfZWXJ5mLYSi2xtiuM5HLBIf2yPZxg07WODghmskA22eGf6ZhJ4_FviKg6I1JFQAKOKbEgfv99AyJnMrGu)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1zDj-TafQvqr8wZq5tqWHJkiux3HZC_LBM17ULkxkYBGg8glQ8Ky_H7IySdI6qn2XngY3zIr_iftKlodnFeyL7fVcRxaHs8qmDdSsvk1gFiHVc7D9U28dCTYscXC-RsSEuaj5Mgie1lpCeNPKngLwl7KADQMFR1nO5VImcUQiR1FiejY)

### What Influences Speed and Effects

- **Genetics and enzyme variations:** Differences in ADH and ALDH genes change how quickly alcohol and acetaldehyde are processed. Research on [PubMed](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXUZcFBPipwcwy8iKzKLxYusv_q92WK85uzJwneh6n2Xxi15DArGzWde9Tq5QrzR_i4EZ2mXvF0ZmdMRCGm0an6wkcnZPKvg_MsjfcnzLyCkLTmIofKN5_geyo_nVGGkAl9g) notes that faster metabolism can sustain stimulant feelings as BAC drops and may relate to drinking patterns, while a consensus on [Reddit's r/medicine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF1yyvXGE4ZqkSm2zURaTkZvVtci1C_TLkpLl5aERYR2s5hsQt0dtdOGlnhx1rNgILF_EDfQDxkt66Nh_-_V8y1L6byQDO1vBOGOK0Z8J43NhE4t3NR9y6v1IozKgwg186cNBMVxLbyCk2Q7GYkya7NsCOMTR8NKkZz67Mlo2JAMX7tEGryBxBtny2ueGcYvoxMMnl21VKRjRzSaZ-iA) highlights that faster processing does not automatically prevent alcohol-related harm because the body is still exposed to toxic metabolites and liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXUZcFBPipwcwy8iKzKLxYusv_q92WK85uzJwneh6n2Xxi15DArGzWde9Tq5QrzR_i4EZ2mXvF0ZmdMRCGm0an6wkcnZPKvg_MsjfcnzLyCkLTmIofKN5_geyo_nVGGkAl9g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXoturtsrQB87JCR_vZdJcNzoCexADgcihgVHdsIuTOdsnsRJx4x4tNaQUIIPf1G_6DTS4En2xIcddixrOrwiwz3cv-OxwaCK7vHVSg3QI5U_8j7yC77P9yzuWN0vAICAwYHtpGfGbtVheSgSnxj1oiPU)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXjf2CekJBW4Ee7Hi2_pECSzoRFWOwRqvwfDuCwtXbsv2yvTjqJFOltti-J2QO4w7Isp89T26-Qnfm3BhVSJyESDveesnrCssMjAIbXSm7VWJvOxGHK10aLRZj9TA2pLYsAtlfOXMuKqoQ176rQFfzQp0Pnh8Fcxfjjg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF1yyvXGE4ZqkSm2zURaTkZvVtci1C_TLkpLl5aERYR2s5hsQt0dtdOGlnhx1rNgILF_EDfQDxkt66Nh_-_V8y1L6byQDO1vBOGOK0Z8J43NhE4t3NR9y6v1IozKgwg186cNBMVxLbyCk2Q7GYkya7NsCOMTR8NKkZz67Mlo2JAMX7tEGryBxBtny2ueGcYvoxMMnl21VKRjRzSaZ-iA)
- **Food and absorption:** Eating before or while drinking slows how fast alcohol moves from the stomach into the small intestine, delaying peak BAC—though it does not change the liver's elimination rate once alcohol is in the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1zDj-TafQvqr8wZq5tqWHJkiux3HZC_LBM17ULkxkYBGg8glQ8Ky_H7IySdI6qn2XngY3zIr_iftKlodnFeyL7fVcRxaHs8qmDdSsvk1gFiHVc7D9U28dCTYscXC-RsSEuaj5Mgie1lpCeNPKngLwl7KADQMFR1nO5VImcUQiR1FiejY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF13T4dFGvJ-2UXqJPDrf6gzfijug39VwIkAZoIxlb5MUp-pgWg4B589iV8NCc7DcfGx7GooE8ofQUMSgIGkfzCzRT2XTf1rfkgNTJ6K4NzpSfK09JEtUVfL50K73kzX-N3Yy_DYNEns1tBV5TkV1HPgfclqtljpE6nKbnoPxbj1pzLsSQ4aNE6HjmiP54u5i0xYvX)
- **Liver health and medications:** Liver conditions slow alcohol breakdown, and medications metabolized by the liver (such as acetaminophen) can create metabolic bottlenecks and liver stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xFmw3GauO56T5L-83bTmGt-bTt1O8S2rgtXDoeoy8_fOavm6j6R2HPb23Vv-Ph4BhISfOugObxDoFodbZG-1nQXJvaeSLToKr_xHGFBjkCPJrMRAzXQCooj4njfZWXJ5mLYSi2xtiuM5HLBIf2yPZxg07WODghmskA22eGf6ZhJ4_FviKg6I1JFQAKOKbEgfv99AyJnMrGu)

For deeper details on enzymes and metabolic pathways, see the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXoturtsrQB87JCR_vZdJcNzoCexADgcihgVHdsIuTOdsnsRJx4x4tNaQUIIPf1G_6DTS4En2xIcddixrOrwiwz3cv-OxwaCK7vHVSg3QI5U_8j7yC77P9yzuWN0vAICAwYHtpGfGbtVheSgSnxj1oiPU) or [Bowling Green State University](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF13T4dFGvJ-2UXqJPDrf6gzfijug39VwIkAZoIxlb5MUp-pgWg4B589iV8NCc7DcfGx7GooE8ofQUMSgIGkfzCzRT2XTf1rfkgNTJ6K4NzpSfK09JEtUVfL50K73kzX-N3Yy_DYNEns1tBV5TkV1HPgfclqtljpE6nKbnoPxbj1pzLsSQ4aNE6HjmiP54u5i0xYvX).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXoturtsrQB87JCR_vZdJcNzoCexADgcihgVHdsIuTOdsnsRJx4x4tNaQUIIPf1G_6DTS4En2xIcddixrOrwiwz3cv-OxwaCK7vHVSg3QI5U_8j7yC77P9yzuWN0vAICAwYHtpGfGbtVheSgSnxj1oiPU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF13T4dFGvJ-2UXqJPDrf6gzfijug39VwIkAZoIxlb5MUp-pgWg4B589iV8NCc7DcfGx7GooE8ofQUMSgIGkfzCzRT2XTf1rfkgNTJ6K4NzpSfK09JEtUVfL50K73kzX-N3Yy_DYNEns1tBV5TkV1HPgfclqtljpE6nKbnoPxbj1pzLsSQ4aNE6HjmiP54u5i0xYvX)Are you looking into **how long alcohol stays in the system** after drinking, **why someone reacts or sobers up differently** , or **how alcohol affects fasting and metabolism**?
